image_description: A polished steel breastplate (cuirass front) held by a human hand against a vertical wooden plank background. The armor features a curved, anatomical shape with a central ridge and rolled edges. It has leather shoulder straps attached via rivets. A watermark text 'www.nidingbane.se' is superimposed across the center of the metal.

artifact_observations.location: Center horizontal band across the breastplate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'www.nidingbane.se' is a website watermark. While legible, it is an artificial overlay not part of the physical scene, potentially confusing segmentation models.

A human thumb/fingers are visible holding the bottom edge. This is a real photographic element, but introduces a biological subject into an object-centric class, which may distract pure object classifiers.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the object belongs to the specific 'breastplate' class rather than generic armor or helmets.
To ensure the metal plate is segmented correctly despite the high-contrast reflections and the overlaying text watermark.
To verify the 3D convexity of the armor plate and distinguish it from the flat wooden background.
To explicitly identify and isolate the text artifact so it is not misinterpreted as surface engraving on the armor.

Confirm that the text is recognized as an overlay and not a defect in the metal generation.
